intro.text: An ardent of the Devotary of the Mind at the Jokasha Monastery in Jah Keved, a linguist working on translating the Dawnchant.

items.text: Once Navani's key to the Dawnchant arrived, Ellista and the other scholars began decoding the old texts. She welcomed the information but refused to believe Dalinar's visions were real.

While others were distracted by the Everstorm, she kept working and found evidence that the Dawnchant was once a shared written language across Roshar, and that the Desolations made it fall out of use as nations turned to their own scripts.

Driven from her reading spots by arguments about the Everstorm, she retreated into the forest, where the ardent Urv found her. He read her notes, spotted the novel she was trying to hide, and offered to lend her its sequel if she helped him translate the Covad Fragment for an unnamed patron.

appearance.text: Like most ardents she shaves her head; she never liked dealing with her hair, and her parents joke that she became an ardent just to shave it off.

personality.text: She dislikes disruption, prefers to be left alone, and can be sceptical and judgmental. She has no interest in the talk of the Everstorm, which she thinks everyone is overreacting to.
Well read and gifted, she makes remarkable progress with the Dawnchant fragments; Urv calls her brilliant.
